name: Yablonsky Product Feed for Kainos.lt
author: Yablonsky

sections.description:
Yablonsky Product Feed for Kainos.lt generates an XML feed that matches Kainos.lt import requirements, including required fields such as product title, price (tax included), manufacturer, main image URL, product URL, and category paths.

It is built for clean operations:
– No external data transfer
– WordPress permissions and nonce-protected actions
– Supports multilingual WooCommerce sites (WPML / Polylang compatible)

Created by Alex Yablonsky (https://yablonsky.io/) — responsible growth systems for businesses and personalities.

Key features

  • Generates Kainos.lt XML feed(s) from published WooCommerce products
  • Multilingual feeds: one XML per active site language (e.g. products-en.xml, products-ru.xml, products-lt.xml)
  • Automatic scheduled regeneration (WP-Cron) + manual “Generate now”
  • Regenerates feed when products are added/updated
  • Stores feeds in: /wp-content/uploads/feeds/
  • WordPress multisite compatible
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Product Feed (Kainos.lt).
  4. Configure schedule and languages.
  5. Click Generate now for the first build.
  6. Your feed files will appear in: /wp-content/uploads/feeds/
sections.faq:
Where are the XML feeds stored?

In /wp-content/uploads/feeds/ (example: products-lt.xml, products-en.xml).

Does it support multilingual stores (WPML/Polylang)?

Yes. The plugin generates a separate feed per active site language.

Does it send data to third-party services?

No. The plugin generates files locally only.

Who can generate or change settings?

Only users with the manage_woocommerce capability.
